dataset: Per-question outputs of HELM Lite release v1.13.0 (Stanford CRFM): every multiple_choice_joint run of MMLU (5 subjects), MedQA and OpenBookQA, first trial. Only benchmarks, subjects, instance ids, option letters, classes, counts and public model names are published.
note: H = HELM's score (answer letter -> option text -> main metric: exact_match for MMLU and OpenBookQA, quasi_exact_match for MedQA), gated against HELM's recorded score; I = 1 when the letter names the gold option itself. Over: H 1, I 0; under: H 0, I 1. A question collides when a wrong option's text is string-identical to the gold's (identical), equal after HELM's normalize_text (quasi_only) or starts with it after normalisation (prefix_only). P2 >= 1 MedQA quasi_only question; P3 MedQA over-credits <= 0.2% of predictions; P4 no model's MedQA rank moves 3+ places; P5 >= 5 prefix_only questions and >= 2 x quasi_only (all benchmarks); P6 >= 1 identical question; P7 >= 3 models have >= 1% of their MedQA outputs unmapped.
